def factor_momentum_persistence_volume_smooth10(df):
    df_copy = df.copy()
    ret_20 = df_copy["close"] / df_copy["close"].shift(20) - 1.0
    up_days = (df_copy["close"] > df_copy["close"].shift(1)).rolling(20, min_periods=20).mean()
    _, _, vol_ratio = alpha_tools.classify_volume_regime(df_copy["volume"], window=20)
    raw_signal = ret_20 * up_days * vol_ratio
    df_copy["factor_momentum_persistence_volume_smooth10"] = raw_signal.ewm(span=10, min_periods=10).mean()
    return df_copy["factor_momentum_persistence_volume_smooth10"]
description: Mutation of factor_momentum_persistence_volume_smooth: increases EMA smoothing window from 5 to 10 days to further reduce noise and improve signal stability, targeting higher ICIR while preserving the core momentum-persistence-volume mechanism.
